rationale: The opening i=gwet-ayo məfqó-way-no-la m-u=kiso, w-gə-mnaʕmí-way-na-la is in verse 10. The continuation beginning mnaʕmí-way-na-la b-u=šalfo and the target maxló-way-no are in verse 11. Both consecutive verses are needed, so replacing 11 with 10 alone would be wrong.

The entry’s Turoyo says ḥamšaḥṣar=yawme, fifteen days, not fourteen. The supplied glossary independently translates the same numeral as fünfzehn in ṭʕy and lḥm, and inputs/texts/MAC_NE_interview_1.txt at /11 likewise translates ḥamšaḥṣar+yawme as fifteen days.

summary: Correct the person of took: I, not we
before: We took the cheese out of the bag
after: I took the cheese out of the bag
rationale: The quoted məfqó-way-no-la is first-person singular, whereas the following mnaʕmí-way-na-la is plural. The edition explicitly distinguishes nahm ich ihn aus dem Beutel heraus, und wir zerkleinerten ihn.

summary: Correct what is poured and the direction of pouring
before: poured it (cheese, f.) into the cauldron
after: poured the water over it (cheese, f.) in the cauldron
rationale: In g-marṯḥó-way-no maye, w-g-maxló-way-no aʕla b-i=baroše, the water is boiled and then poured over the cheese in the pot. Aʕla means over it and b-i=baroše locates the action in the pot. The edition confirms schüttete es über (den Käse) im Topf. Preserve the editors’ feminine-cheese annotation while correcting the action.
The preterit of ausschütten has double t: schüttete ... aus.
